controls.meaning: Recommended default, not architecture: maximum rows returned per query; the gateway truncates beyond it and sets the truncation flag.
Recommended default, not architecture: maximum serialized result size per query in bytes; the gateway truncates beyond it and sets the truncation flag.
Recommended default, not architecture: SQL command timeout; the gateway cancels the command and reports a sanitized timeout error.
Recommended default, not architecture: queries executing at once across all aliases; further requests are refused with an audited budget event.
Recommended default, not architecture: executed queries allowed per investigation; further requests are refused with an audited budget event.
